# hackerone_asset_scope (Resource)

Places an organization asset into a program's scope (the 'in scope' list), controlling submission and bounty eligibility.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_id` (String) Numeric ID of the asset to place in scope.
- `organization_id` (String) Numeric ID of the organization that owns the asset.
- `program_id` (String) Numeric ID of the program whose scope the asset joins.

### Optional

- `eligible_for_bounty` (Boolean) Whether this asset is eligible for bounties. Defaults to `false`.
- `eligible_for_submission` (Boolean) Whether reports may be submitted against this asset. Defaults to `true`.
- `instruction` (String) Guidance shown to hackers for this scope entry.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID `organization_id/asset_id/program_id/scope_id`.
- `scope_id` (String) The structured-scope ID created by the binding (as reported in the program's structured_scopes).
